Verification

Internal exhaustive equivalence and the official Julia verifier are separate authorities. This layer inventory is explanatory; authoritative result statements come only from structural claim records.

LayerAuthorityMeaningCurrent state
Training consistencyVisible rowsEvery permitted observed training row must match before a candidate can advance.Implemented in the exact learner and artifact checks.
Internal equivalenceRust exhaustive XAG evaluationThe emitted circuit implements its completed table over the declared full input domain; this is not official verification.Implemented for disclosed controls, synthetic fixtures, and candidate artifact construction.
Deterministic rerunByte-identical fresh artifactsTwo fresh eligible runs bind identical completed table, circuit, and artifact bytes.Implemented for disclosed controls and required per future blind candidate; no current visible candidate pair is present.
Official Julia verificationOfficial Julia verifierThe unmodified official verifier confirms the bound candidate, dataset, samples, gates, exact accuracy, and bit accuracy.Wrapper integrated; historical disclosed-control passes are branch-bound and the current blind official record is absent.
Sealed evaluatorFrozen custodian and evaluator boundaryA previously frozen visible-only candidate receives one confirmation without exposing sealed rows or private digests to the proposer.Absent; no sealed result or sanitized authenticated attestation is present.

Prepare and verify the repository

Create the pinned local environment, validate vendored skills, and run the complete local baseline from a clean checkout.

make setup
make skills
make test

Reproduce disclosed controls

DATA_ROOT is the disclosed v1 archive root; OUTPUT_ROOT is a fresh artifact directory. This is a disclosed-control reproduction only.

cargo run --locked --release --bin occam-circuit-hmyuuu -- \
  solve-v1 "$DATA_ROOT" "$OUTPUT_ROOT"

Run one frozen public baseline

PUBLIC_ROOT is the reviewed public bundle, OPAQUE_ID is its nonidentifying instance ID, and OUTPUT_DIR is a fresh runner-owned cell directory.

cargo run --locked --release --bin occam-circuit-hmyuuu -- \
  frozen-baseline "$PUBLIC_ROOT" "$OPAQUE_ID" "$OUTPUT_DIR" \
  --method zero-fill --metrics-json "$OUTPUT_DIR/metrics.json"

Run the frozen Care-BDD candidate

PUBLIC_ROOT, OPAQUE_ID, and ALGORITHM_SEED must come from the frozen visible-only design; OUTPUT_DIR must be fresh.

cargo run --locked --release --bin occam-circuit-hmyuuu -- \
  learn-care "$PUBLIC_ROOT" "$OPAQUE_ID" "$OUTPUT_DIR" \
  --folds 5 --seed "$ALGORITHM_SEED" --policy reuse-sibling \
  --max-order-evals 32

Run bounded exact SAT resynthesis

INPUT_CIRCUIT is an already exact circuit; OUTPUT_DIR is fresh. The six-input and 285-second limits are frozen and the outer runner still owns the 300-second cap.

cargo run --locked --all-features --release \
  --bin occam-circuit-hmyuuu -- \
  resynthesize "$INPUT_CIRCUIT" "$OUTPUT_DIR" \
  --max-cut-inputs 6 --deadline-seconds 285 \
  --metrics-json "$OUTPUT_DIR/metrics.json"

Run one bounded evidence cell

REPO_ROOT is the clean source checkout; RUN_ROOT and CELL_ID identify one immutable frozen cell; PUBLIC_ROOT, OPAQUE_ID, and ALGORITHM_SEED remain visible-only inputs.

"$REPO_ROOT/.venv/bin/python" "$REPO_ROOT/scripts/run-experiment.py" \
  --run-root "$RUN_ROOT" --cell-id "$CELL_ID" \
  --metrics-json "$RUN_ROOT/cells/$CELL_ID/metrics.json" -- \
  "$REPO_ROOT/target/release/occam-circuit-hmyuuu" \
  learn-care "$PUBLIC_ROOT" "$OPAQUE_ID" \
  "$RUN_ROOT/cells/$CELL_ID" --folds 5 \
  --seed "$ALGORITHM_SEED" --policy reuse-sibling --max-order-evals 32

Invoke the fail-closed Julia wrapper

The custodian supplies absolute non-symlink JULIA_BIN, VERIFY_JL, CIRCUIT, and DATASET paths plus the frozen EXPECTED_GATES and safe INSTANCE label.

"$REPO_ROOT/scripts/verify-julia.sh" \
  "$JULIA_BIN" "$VERIFY_JL" "$CIRCUIT" "$DATASET" \
  "$EXPECTED_GATES" "$INSTANCE"

Create an immutable official record

The authorized custodian supplies immutable absolute paths. OFFICIAL_RECORD must not exist and private inputs stay outside the proposer report.

"$REPO_ROOT/.venv/bin/python" "$REPO_ROOT/scripts/record-verification.py" \
  --manifest "$MANIFEST" --julia-bin "$JULIA_BIN" \
  --verify-jl "$VERIFY_JL" --dataset "$DATASET" \
  --output "$OFFICIAL_RECORD"

Replay the promotion decision

PROMOTION_REQUEST is one canonical evidence request and PROMOTION_DECISION is a new output path. A non-absent comparison additionally requires the reviewed trust policy.

"$REPO_ROOT/.venv/bin/python" "$REPO_ROOT/scripts/check-promotion.py" \
  --request "$PROMOTION_REQUEST" --output "$PROMOTION_DECISION"

Regenerate the report

Regenerate every offline HTML and Markdown view from reports/data/project.json.

make report

Verify the report

Validate the canonical source, structural claim policy, evidence bindings, links, offline assets, and generated bytes.

make report-check
